6.192 rsPostSortAggregateInGroupFilterExpression
rsPostSortAggregateInGroupFilterExpression is a critical error that will occur when a First, Last, or
Previous aggregate function is present within a Filter.FilterExpression or a Filter.FilterValues element
within a Group element.
